weather_report:
Subiaco drifts through the small hours under a gentle scatter of cloud, the sky loosening toward a clearer pre-dawn. The air feels quiet and cool, the kind of night that muffles sound and lets a few stubborn stars wink between passing veils. By first light those veils look set to thin further, leaving a clean, bright morning with only a few brushstrokes of cloud for company. Expect a sunny day that sharpens quickly; the UV will rise with purpose after breakfast, likely high by late morning in this spring stretch, so the sun will have some bite even if the air still feels mild.

Dress for layers: a light jacket now, easy to shrug off to short sleeves as the light settles in; hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen belong near the door. It looks like a day for ordinary pleasures done unrushed—airing the house, a walk to pick up bread, watering the balcony herbs, cycling a couple of errands before the sun turns insistent, then a shaded pause with a book after lunch. Clarity, not drama, is the theme.
